column2: Publish the regency and open nominations.
A Regent Until the Ducal Election

The constitution has established a ducal office, but the council has yet to name its holder. A regency will administer the civil list while the elected ministers conduct public business. The delegates can choose a local burgher or seek a candidate from a foreign royal house. A court abroad must agree to the invitation before any candidate can be crowned. The office will be bound by the union's constitution and will not transfer the government to a foreign country.
Invite a Candidate from the House of Orange-Nassau
Invite a Candidate from the House of Orange-Nassau

The council can send a delegation to the Dutch court requesting a candidate from the House of Orange-Nassau. The invitation offers the constitutional ducal office, with the legislature retaining control of taxation and ministerial government. The foreign court may decline. Agreement provides a nominee, whose coronation must still be funded and approved by the union.
Recommend a candidate under the union constitution.
Decline the invitation and recall the delegation.
A Ducal Invitation from the United Boer Government

The council can send a delegation to the Dutch court requesting a candidate from the House of Orange-Nassau. The invitation offers the constitutional ducal office, with the legislature retaining control of taxation and ministerial government. The foreign court may decline. Agreement provides a nominee, whose coronation must still be funded and approved by the union. The delegates ask our ministers whether the royal house will put forward a willing candidate. Acceptance recognises the constitutional terms of the office, without creating a personal union or a new imperial dependency.
Receive the nominee and prepare the constitutional oath.
The House of Orange-Nassau Accepts the Invitation

The delegation has returned with the agreement of the Dutch court. A candidate from the House of Orange-Nassau has been recommended for the ducal office. The councillors will now arrange an oath to the constitution and present the civil list to the legislature. Until the coronation, the regency continues. Neither the invitation nor its acceptance changes the union's borders or diplomatic dependency.
Return the envoys and reopen the nominations.
The Foreign Court Declines

The ministers of the Dutch court have declined to recommend a candidate. The delegation has recovered its unused reserve, and the regency remains in place. The council can seek another royal house or choose a burgher from the united districts. A renewed approach to the same court will have to wait until the previous refusal has ceased to dominate correspondence.

Nominate a Duke from the United Districts
Nominate a Duke from the United Districts

The council can choose a burgher from the united districts for the constitutional ducal office. This places the responsibility for the dynasty at home and requires no foreign invitation. The nominee must still swear the constitution at a separately funded coronation.
Present the nominee to the united legislature.
A Burgher Chosen for the Ducal Office

The district delegates have agreed on a local nominee for the ducal office. The choice reconciles a hereditary constitutional head of state with the authority of the common legislature. Before taking office, the nominee must swear to uphold the constitution and accept the limits of the civil list. Ministers have asked the council to arrange the coronation, while the regency continues to administer the office.
Crown the Duke of the United Boer Duchies
Crown the Duke of the United Boer Duchies

The nominee will swear the constitution before delegates from the Orange, Vaal and northern districts. The legislature must fund the ceremony and civil-list arrangements. The completed coronation will be announced to foreign governments, while the union retains its existing constitution and diplomatic position.
Receive the oath and proclaim the Duke.
The Coronation of the Duke

The delegates have assembled for the oath of the new Duke. Before the common legislature and the district representatives, the nominee has sworn to uphold the constitution, respect the elected ministers and govern within the approved civil list. The regency ends with the completion of the ceremony. The ducal office belongs to the united state: its foreign connections confer neither ownership of the country nor authority to dispense with its constitution.
Publish the coronation in the diplomatic register.
A Duke Crowned in the United Boer Duchies

Reports from Winburg announce the completion of the ducal coronation. The new head of state has sworn the union constitution before delegates from its constituent districts. The elected legislature retains authority over public expenditure and ministers remain bound by the charter. Foreign chancelleries will now correspond with an established ducal court rather than a regency. The ceremony changes the holder of the constitutional office, while existing frontier treaties and diplomatic obligations remain in force.

The Programme of the United Government

The united government must decide how to finance its next three-year programme. A supplementary appropriation of GBP 500 can pay clerks to reconcile district accounts and support court registers, improving tax collection and administration, or pay teachers and prepare common school registers, improving education. These are temporary grants, not the permanent audit office or school system, which must still be established separately. Keeping expenditure within the existing budget preserves the treasury and tightens collection, but leaves education to advance more slowly. Only one programme can operate at a time.
